answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. What survives to the canyon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The gale lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the relic is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on time-locked work history, split across independent auditors, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
